text: Rejected (2026-11): moving runPipelineResponse into a goroutine so the device read loop stays free during the webhook and TTS. The ping concern does not apply, because the server sends pings from its own goroutine and the amoledesp32 client cancels a run itself after 60 s with no events. The real failure (the read deadline expiring during a long run) was fixed by setting the deadline before each read. Revisit only if cancel handling during the webhook wait becomes necessary.
